Palla ex A.Kern. |synonyms_ref ={{APNI2|id=244248|name=''Schoenoplectiella mucronata''}} }} '''''Schoenoplectiella mucronata''''' is a species of flowering plant in the [[Cyperaceae|sedge family]] known by the common names '''bog bulrush''',{{Cite PLANTS |symbol=SCMU10 |taxon=Schoenoplectiella mucronata |access-date=2020-07-05 }} '''rough-seed bulrush''',{{Cite web|title=ROUGH SEED / BOG BULRUSH (Schoenoplectus mucronatus) Seeds 'Bush Tucker Plant'|url=https://edibleoz.com.au/products/rough-seed-bog-bulrush-schoenoplectus-mucronatus-seeds-bush-tucker-food|access-date=2020-07-05|website=Edible Oz|language=en}} and '''ricefield bulrush'''. == Distribution == It is native to Eurasia, Africa and Australia.{{cite POWO |id=77106233-1 |title=''Schoenoplectiella mucronata'' (L.) J.Jung & H.K.Choi |access-date=2020-07-05}} == Habitat and description == It grows in moist and wet terrestrial habitat, and in shallow water. It is a perennial herb growing from a short, hard [[rhizome]]. The erect, three-angled stems grow in dense clumps and can reach a metre tall. The leaves take the form of sheaths wrapped around the base of stem, but they generally do not have blades. The [[inflorescence]] is a headlike cluster of cone-shaped spikelets accompanied by an angled, stiff [[bract]] which may look like a continuation of the stem.{{rp|228–30}} It is a [[weed]] of [[Paddy field|rice fields]] in [[California]].[http://www.ipm.ucdavis.edu/PMG/WEEDS/ricefield_bulrush.html UC Davis IPM][http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242101173 Flora of North America] ==Taxonomy== [[File:Schoenop mucron 200305-P9003264 punc.JPG|thumb|left|180px|Forming a dense thickets along ditches]] {{As of|2020|July}}, [[Plants of the World Online]] lists 35 taxonomic synonyms of ''Schoenoplectiella mucronata'', and the [[Council of Heads of Australasian Herbaria]] lists two. It was first described as ''Scirpus mucronatus'' in 1753 by [[Carl Linnaeus]].{{cite journal|author=Linnaeus, C. |date=1753|title=''Scirpus''|journal= Species Plantarum|volume=1|pages=50|url=https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/358068}} In 1889 [[Eduard Palla]] transferred it to the genus, ''[[Schoenoplectus]]'',{{cite journal|author=Kerner, A. |date=1889|title= Schedae ad Floram Exsiccatam Austro-Hungaricam |volume=5|page=91|url=https://bibdigital.rjb.csic.es/viewer/13783/?offset=#page=97&viewer=picture&o=bookmark&n=0&q=}} and ''Schoenoplectus mucronatus'' was the accepted name until 2010 when it was transferred to the genus, ''[[Schoenoplectiella]]'' by Jongduk Jung and Hong-Kuen Choi.{{cite journal|last1=Jung|first1=Jongduk|last2=Choi|first2=Hong-Keun|title=Systematic Rearrangement of Korean Scirpus L. s.l.
